scope: Bryce Aron INDY NXT races and the qualifying source used for each race, 2024-2026

contract.observed: A timestamp exists in a retained source heartbeat, replay frame, or BryceCast Race Control snapshot.
contract.interpolated: A 1 Hz consumer row holds or derives state between observed timing events. It is never counted as an observed source frame.
contract.unavailable: The expected canonical session remains in the ledger with the sources searched and a reason.
contract.position: Timing-line/display order only. No source in this ledger is GPS.

racetools.finding: No RaceTools 2026 directory, direct-session inventory, or annual archive was published at the checked endpoints. The root index still ends at the 2025 directory and 2024 annual ZIP.

timing71.finding: The full 2024-26 archive inventory is retained in the content-addressed lake manifest and re-analyzed before coverage builds. Labels are insufficient identity proof; Bryce roster reconstruction is required.

brycecastRaceControl.finding: Only the five needed late-2026 session subsets were exported. The live database was not copied, mutated, or restarted.

rejectedSources.0895cf60-5926-438b-bf15-c73a99af4043: Milwaukee file is an INDYCAR Scott Dixon session despite its NXT label; no Bryce roster observation.
